verdict: Dr. Ayaz pulled up dressed like he's ready to derive vector spaces for three hours straight before sprinting to his car to dodge office hours.
detailedQuote: The crisp white button-down screams 'I read off 100 PowerPoint slides per lecture,' while those maroon Puma sneakers prove he's legally prepared to outrun any student begging for a grade curve. Pairing corporate mid-level management slacks with gym shoes is a crime even linear algebra cannot solve.

inventory.name: Off-White Wrinkled Button-Up Shirt of Bureaucratic Torment
inventory.description: A pale, lifeless dress shirt stuffed into trousers so tight it looks like it's holding in ten years of unread student emails.

inventory.name: Navy Blue High-Waisted Trousers of No Grade Rounding
inventory.description: Pleated formal pants cinched up to the ribcage to ensure zero motion, maximum discomfort, and absolute refusal to round up a 79.9%.

inventory.name: Maroon Puma Running Shoes for Office Hour Escape
inventory.description: Casual maroon runners stuck onto a semi-formal outfit like an afterthought, specifically designed for fleeing campus the second the clock hits 5:00 PM.

inventory.name: Rectangular Wire-Rimmed Glasses of Glancing Judgement
inventory.description: Standard-issue academic specs used exclusively to glare over the top when someone asks a question clearly answered on slide 42.
